summary: Dreamland Ltd, a Hong Kong based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing the initial closing of its self-directed best-efforts follow-on public offering (FPO). The company sold 3,400,000 Class A ordinary shares at US $0.75 per share and 17,000,000 common warrants (immediately exercised for US $850,000), generating gross proceeds of US $3,400,000. Proceeds are allocated 30% to event projects, 20% to IP licenses, and 50% to working capital. The FPO remains open for additional securities. This is a routine capital formation event, not a special situation requiring classification.
